title: Senior Project Manager New
description:
**Our Why At Dotmatics**



At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision\-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.


**We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.**



We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best\-of\-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi\-dimensional decision\-making.



Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.


**Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics**



Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.



You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote\-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud\-based scientific research R\&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.


**We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.**

**What do we need**



We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to manage large Scientific SaaS delivery \& implementations projects, to ensure that our clients are reaching their desired outcomes and adopting our solutions. The structure of projects are like other enterprise deployments but centre around enabling Customers to use configured software within their business area of expertise.



You will be in a unique position to leverage your advanced in\-depth SaaS Implementation/delivery skills, processes management, and interpersonal skills across many clients, ranging from the top pharmaceutical companies in the world to the leading food providers, and start\-ups focused on ultra\-rare diseases. You will be an advocate of Dotmatics, engaging stakeholders ranging from bench scientists up to Senior Manager levels to effectively communicate Actions, Owners, Timelines, to balance risks and have the right conversations to protect, propose, and allow science to prosper.


**In this role you will get to**


* Develop, plan and manage the implementation of challenging Customer projects across disparate organizations in line with the Dotmatics project lifecycle using agile methodologies and hybrid\-agile approaches.
* Lead full cycle project delivery for complex enterprise level SaaS software
* Manage large technical \& digital transformation programmes
* Develop project objectives, by identifying requirements and barriers to projects, including cost, time, scope, and resources.
* Lead resolutions of any customer or team problem related to their discipline/project.
* Proactively identify problems that challenge our scale or business or customer direction.
* Effectively communicate and support changes to adapt to challenges by taking accountability for the project’s success. This may require working across a number of different aspects, e.g. equipment, business processes, vendor management, technical implementation, deployment and training.
* Ensure the project is compliant with relevant standards, regulatory requirements and contractual agreements while suggesting and coordinating system improvements
* Provide overall leadership to team leads and project staff both intra\- and inter\-company.
* Advocate for Dotmatics’ interests by working closely with Services Consultants, Developers, Product Management, Leadership, Legal, Sales and other Customer Operations functions ensuring overall success of the project(s)
* Prepare and present internal and external executive briefings, including recommendations for executive action
* Manage of project expenditures, both capital and expense and partnering with finance to ensure timely and accurate service invoicing for projects
* Lead the creation of proposals and estimates for Service Delivery projects from project extensions with existing customers to working on new proposals with Sales and Pre\-Sales

  


**We are looking for people who** hold 10\+ years experience in SaaS Enterprise implementation/delivery projects, hold a Project Management Certification such as PMP, and be a Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or equivalent. You will demonstrate experience in successfully setting up agile project deliveries and be able to demonstrate experience of managing SaaS configuration projects throughout their life cycle.

  


**The Key Skills**


* **Scrum Events**: Organising and facilitating scrum events in the capacity of Scrum Master
* **Leading projects**: Managing the delivery of SaaS enterprise configuration projects that may have significant risks
* **Leading Projects**: Ability to manage projects for T1/Enterprise customers or multiple concurrent projects for T2 customers
* **Managing stakeholders**: Engaging with senior stakeholders and customers to understand their needs and ensure their expectations are met
* **Building teams**: Motivating, managing, and developing teams of globally dispersed people, consultants, and organizations globally disbursed teams, in a virtual setting
* **Change Management:** : Advising, coaching and supporting customers through organisational change initiatives to aid software adoption and uptake
* **Ensuring quality**: Ensuring that projects meet quality, schedule, and financial goals, and align with Company ORKs (Organisational Key Results)
* **Managing risk**: Identifying and managing obstacles and risks, and developing contingency plans.
* **Resolution Management:** Leading issues to resolution that have broad business impacts, providing executive teams with strategic recommendations and solutions.
* **Improving delivery**: Continuously improving the delivery process and team performance. Develop project objectives, by identifying requirements and barriers to projects, including cost, time, scope, and resources.
* **Managing costs**: Managing multi\-million dollar program expenditures, both capital and expense and partnering with finance to ensure timely and accurate service invoicing for projects, while ensuring alignment with company OKR’s (Organisational Key Results) \& financial targets
* **Managing contracts**: Leading the creation of proposals and estimates for Service Delivery projects from project extensions with existing customers to working on new proposals with Sales and Pre\-Sales
* A background in either chemistry, biology or life sciences

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.



By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.


**Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.**

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
About the Role  

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Technical Project Manager / Project Coordinator to support technical and engineering projects from planning through execution.  

This opportunity is particularly suitable for candidates with a strong technical or engineering background who want to build a career in technical project management, engineering coordination and R\&D environments.  

Key Responsibilities  

Coordinate technical projects from planning through execution.  

Work closely with engineering, R\&D and cross\-functional teams to ensure project milestones are achieved.  

Track project schedules, deliverables, dependencies and action items.  

Prepare project plans, meeting minutes, status updates and progress reports.  

Monitor project risks, delays and dependencies and escalate issues where required.  

Coordinate communication between internal stakeholders and engineering teams.  

Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure.  

Maintain project documentation and project trackers.  

Support process improvement and development of efficient project\-management practices.  

Assist technical teams with planning, coordination and execution of project activities.  

Required Skills  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.  

Excellent written and verbal communication.  

Good planning, coordination and organizational skills.  

Ability to manage multiple activities and meet deadlines.  

Strong follow\-up and ownership mindset.  

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.  

Willingness to learn and work with multidisciplinary technical teams.  

Familiarity with project management tools such as Zoho Projects, Jira, Microsoft Project or similar tools is an advantage.  

Qualifications  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in one of the following or a related field:  

Engineering  

Electronics  

Electrical Engineering  

Computer Science  

Physics  

Mathematics  

Aerospace  

Remote Sensing  

Science  

Preferred  

Freshers with strong technical aptitude and good academic performance are encouraged to apply.  

Candidates with exposure to engineering, technical projects, research projects or project coordination will have an advantage.  

Interest in radar, aerospace, electronics, drones, GIS, remote sensing or embedded systems is a plus.  

Why Consider This Opportunity?  

Work alongside multidisciplinary technical and engineering teams.  

Gain exposure to technology\-driven projects.  

Build expertise in technical project coordination and management.  

Opportunity for professional growth in an innovative technology environment.

title: Transformation Program Manager
description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


**Your Role**
-------------

The role owns the end\-to\-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go\-live sign\-off.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*

* **Stakeholder leadership and CXO communication** : operate as the single point of confidence for the CEO/CXO group. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection .
* **Program shaping and value ownership –** convert leadership intent into a sequenced roadmap, funding envelope and defensible business case; stay accountable for benefit realisation well beyond deployment
* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A** **doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------

* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised
* A program taken through serious trouble – a failing vendor, slipped go\-live, funding freeze or organised pushback – with a candid account of the recovery
**What you will love about working here**
-----------------------------------------

* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Senior Services Program Manager, Actimize (LMS Administrator)
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.


**So, what’s the role all about?**


As an LMS \& Learning Technology Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting and eventually owning the end\-to\-end LMS implementation, day\-to\-day administration, integrations, reporting, and continuous improvement of Actimize University’s learning platform. The role will work closely with Learning \& Development, Content Development, Trainers, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure a seamless learner and administrator experience.


**How will you make an impact?**


* **LMS implementation and administration:** Support and eventually own end\-to\-end LMS implementation, configuration, testing, and rollout. Manage users, enrollments, learning plans, courses, certifications, permissions, and workflows. Configure and maintain LMS features based on AU business requirements. Coordinate with LMS vendors and internal IT teams for integrations and issue resolution.
* **Learning operations:** Manage training registrations, learner access, course assignments, and certification workflows. Ensure LMS data and learning records are accurate and up to date. Provide operational support to trainers, content developers, administrators, and learners. Identify and resolve issues proactively to minimize disruption.
* **Reporting and analytics:** Develop and maintain dashboards and reports covering learner activity, course completion, certifications, training participation, and other AU KPIs. Provide actionable insights to improve learner engagement and operational efficiency. Automate recurring reports and administrative processes wherever possible.
* **Content and digital learning enablement:** Partner with content developers to publish and maintain self\-paced learning content. Support SCORM/xAPI and other digital learning standards as applicable. Ensure content is correctly configured, tested, and production\-ready within the LMS.
* **Continuous improvement and innovation:** Identify opportunities to automate and simplify LMS processes. Explore AI and emerging learning technologies to improve learner experience and operational efficiency. Establish and maintain LMS administration standards, processes, and documentation.

**Have you got what it takes?**


* 5–8 years of experience in LMS administration, Learning Technology, or Learning Operations.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise LMS platforms such as Sana, Docebo, Cornerstone, Moodle, SuccessFactors, or similar.
* Experience in LMS implementation, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of digital learning, SCORM, learner management, and certification workflows.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills; experience with Excel/Power BI is desirable.
* Experience working with external vendors and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take end\-to\-end ownership.

**You will have an advantage if you also have:**


* Experience supporting a large\-scale LMS implementation.
* Exposure to APIs, integrations, SSO, and learning technology ecosystems.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning platforms and automation.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure is an advantage.
* Experience in professional services, enterprise software, or technology training environments.

**What success looks like**


Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:


* Successfully support the AU LMS implementation and rollout.
* Independently manage day\-to\-day LMS operations.
* Establish robust LMS administration processes and governance.
* Improve automation and reduce manual administrative effort.
* Provide reliable learning analytics and reporting.
* Deliver a smooth experience for learners, trainers, content developers, and stakeholders.
* Become the go\-to SME for AU’s learning technology ecosystem.

**Key competencies**


Ownership \| Learning Technology \| Problem Solving \| Stakeholder Management \| Automation Mindset \| Attention to Detail \| Agility \| Continuous Improvement


**What’s in it for you?**


Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!


**Enjoy NiCE\-FLEX!**


At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.


Requisition ID: 11771
  

Reporting to: Tech Manager, Professional Services, Actimize
  

Role Type: Individual Contributor


***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Project Manager
description:
**Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law**



Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our fast\-growing law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian\-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

  

Are you ready to join one of the fastest\-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don't just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself and helps build the operational infrastructure that makes life\-changing legal work possible at scale.

 **Role Objective**



We are seeking a certified Project Manager to join our team. This role requires a detail\-oriented professional who can manage multiple concurrent initiatives, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive projects to successful completion in a fast\-paced, deadline\-intensive environment.

  

The ideal candidate will bring structure, process excellence, and strategic thinking to support our mission while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

 **Responsibilities/Duties:**



This position works closely with U.S.\-based leadership and internal teams to track progress, manage project documentation, and ensure operational tasks stay on schedule.

 **Project Coordination**


* Support the execution of operational and process improvement projects across multiple teams
* Maintain project plans, task trackers, and project documentation
* Track milestones and deliverables to ensure projects remain on schedule
* Assist in coordinating meetings, preparing agendas, and documenting action items
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure assigned tasks are completed


**Workflow \& Operations Tracking**


* Monitor operational workflows and identify delays or bottlenecks
* Maintain dashboards or trackers that provide visibility into project status
* Ensure project updates and documentation remain organized and accessible
* Assist with reporting project progress to leadership


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**


* Coordinate work between operations, legal teams, and administrative staff
* Communicate project updates and status reports clearly to internal stakeholders
* Escalate risks or blockers to leadership when needed
* Help ensure teams remain aligned on priorities and deadlines


**Technical Skills**


* Experience with project management or task tracking tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
* Strong Microsoft Office or Google Workspace skills
* Comfortable creating trackers, reports, and project documentation
* Ability to quickly learn new software systems


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Project management certifications  

such as PMP, Scrum, or Agile certifications are preferred but not required
* Experience supporting process improvement or operational efficiency initiatives
* Experience working with distributed or remote teams

  


**Professional Attributes**


* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Detail\-oriented with strong follow\-through
* Comfortable working in a structured, process\-driven environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously
* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking skills

  


**Work Requirements**



Must have reliable high\-speed internet



Professional home office setup



Ability to work **Arizona** **business** **hours (****U.S.** **Mountain** **Time)**

 **Compensation**

  


$1,200 \- $1,600 USD Monthly

 **Schedule**  

Must work Arizona business hours (8 AM \- 5 PM Arizona time, Monday\-Friday) to be available for real\-time collaboration with US\-based leadership and legal teams

  

Reliable high\-speed internet connection and professional home office setup

title: Sr. Project Manager
description:
**About Snipp**

  

Snipp Interactive is a global provider of promotions and loyalty technology, helping brands turn transactions into relationships. Our platform supports receipt\-based promotions, consumer rebates, and enterprise loyalty solutions \- trusted by leading CPG, retail, and B2B companies worldwide.

 **The Opportunity**

  

Snipp is seeking a sharp, adaptable Senior Project Manager to join our growing team. Snipp is a global loyalty and promotions technology company. We run receipt\-validated promotions, rebates, loyalty programs, digital offers, and sweepstakes for many of the world's largest CPG, QSR, retail, and beverage brands and their agencies. You'll own delivery on a portfolio of programs inside accounts we already serve, from sales handoff through launch, reporting, and wrap.

  

You'll manage the delivery of rebate, promotion, and sweepstakes programs from sales handoff through launch and reporting, working closely with clients, internal teams, and distributed development teams. You'll act as the liaison between Clients, Sales, and Engineering, Creative, and Legal, owning scope, timelines, budget, risk, and communication across each program. You'll report to the Team Lead, Project Management, and join a distributed PM team working across North America, Europe, and India. **What****you'll****do****:**

  

* Own intake and scoping from sales handoff. Turn the signed contract into requirements, milestones, owners, and a delivery plan.
* Configure and validate program setup on the Snipp platform: promotion and game mechanics, receipt processing and validation rules, offer and reward logic, and client reporting.
* Own the legal and compliance path on every program: official rules, prize structure and fulfillment, privacy and data handling, and client legal review.
* Own QA and UAT. Test each program in staging and production before and after launch, run client UAT, log and chase defects.
* Surface risk early. Flag slipping dates, stalled dependencies, and clients who have gone quiet before they turn into escalations, and bring a mitigation option with the cost and effort attached.
* Manage scope and change requests. Assess impact, quantify cost and effort, and secure written client approval before work starts.
* Manage multiple concurrent client programs, own deadlines, and communicate priorities clearly to clients and developers across time zones.
* Escalate and help resolve participant\-facing issues that require tier\-1 support.
* Coordinate reward fulfillment, prize vendors, and agency partners, and hold them to the dates they commit to build a deep understanding of each client's brand standards, internal approval workflows, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate program tracking and reporting for both clients and internal stakeholders.
* Be creative and excited to learn new concepts. This is an evolving field and requires an adaptable and curious mind to excel.
### **Requirements**

**What****we're****looking for:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in project management, digital/marketing operations, marketing technology or a client\-facing agency role.
* + Master's degree preferred.
* 5 to 7 years of project or program management experience, with at least 2 of those years running client\-facing programs in promotions, loyalty, shopper marketing, marketing technology, or a digital agency. Direct experience working alongside developers is required.
* Business\-fluent spoken and written English required. Candidates must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with enterprise clients and distributed teams across North America and Europe.
* Excellent client service skills with diplomatic written and verbal communication. You'll be writing directly to enterprise brand and agency stakeholders.
* Solid understanding of the full program lifecycle, from intake and requirements through QA, launch, and reporting, including the ability to scope requirements and configure platform features yourself.
* Comfort with technical concepts, the confidence to ask engineering the right questions, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, client\-friendly language.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) and Zoho CRM and Zoho Projects, or directly comparable CRM and project management tooling. Working familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus for reviewing creative assets, not a requirement.Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; experience with modern PM tooling a plus.
* Proven ability to juggle multiple concurrent, quick\-turn projects with shifting priorities.
* Flexible schedule; comfortable working with distributed, international teams across time zones, including occasional early calls with our European and Indian teams.
* Exposure to promotions and sweepstakes compliance (official rules, prize fulfillment, US and Canadian regulations) is a strong plus.
* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 or CSM is a plus, not a requirement.
 **Location:**

  

* Remote within India. Snipp is distributed nationally and internationally, so most communication happens electronically.

This role supports North American and European clients and delivery teams. Plan on a shift with meaningful overlap into the window, including client calls in the evening.  
* 

**Compensation:**

  

* The typical hiring range for this role is ₹24–36L annually. Base pay will be determined based on role\-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

title: Intern - Project Coordinator
description:
### **Description**

  

As a **Project Coordinator**, your role will be vital in **coordinating and ensuring the successful execution** of assigned projects. You will closely collaborate with other project managers, team members, stakeholders, and customers. Project Coordinators are required to have strong customer management skills as they are customer\-facing. The role also involves interacting with other groups within the organization, such as Product Owners, Solution Management, and Sales. Responsibilities of the Project Coordinator include planning, executing, and finalizing projects within strict deadlines and budget constraints. This includes coordinating the efforts of team members and third\-party contractors or consultants to ensure that projects are delivered according to plan. The Project Coordinator will also define the project's objectives and oversee quality control throughout its life cycle.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Responsibilities*** + Assist the PMO Manager in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects to ensure they run smoothly and stay on track. Collaborate with the PMO Manager to plan, develop, and deliver communications and engagement activities regarding PM methodologies, fostering understanding about key areas. Escalate critical issues promptly to the PMO Manager, providing detailed context and potential solutions.
	+ Consolidate and maintain project plans with customer project managers, prioritize projects, align resources, manage dependencies, and report on project scope, schedule and budget progress, and resource allocation.
	+ Monitor project progress continuously and create detailed scheduled reports on measurable items, such as milestones and deliverables. Manage financial and resource control to track and analyze project data for risk mitigation.
	+ Ensure project documentation is maintained. Proactively monitor and report project progress to executives, highlighting and resolving risk factors.
	+ Understands and adheres to all requirements of the Quality Management System and the Information Security Management System.
	+ Foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders and collaborate to define project objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
	+ Communicate proactively with all personnel to encourage, identify problems, create solutions, and implement efficiency improvements.
	+ Understand and adhere to all requirements of the Quality Management System and the Information Security Management System.
* + Execution
	+ Decision Making
	+ Customer Relationship Management
	+ Communication
	+ Project Management
	+ Team Management
	+ Business Acumen
	+ Builds trust\-based relationships
	+ Critical Thinking
	+ Leadership

title: Program Manager, AI Data Ops
description:
**About AiDASH**  

  

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.



The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.



Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

#### **The Role**



AiDASH is looking for a high\-agency Program Manager to help scale our AI Data Ops function: the team responsible for sourcing, processing, and annotating the satellite and remote sensing imagery that powers our AI/ML models.



This role is a new addition to the leadership team, created specifically to bring an **automation\-first, numbers\-backed, process\-driven** operating model to how Ops runs . This role is designed to reduce operational complexity over time, not to manage individual queues or projects indefinitely. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, vendor management, and data science delivery, helping AI Data Ops evolve from a fast\-scaling function into a well\-designed, repeatable operating system.



You will need to zoom in to solve real problems on the ground — a stuck vendor SLA, a high priority escalation, a broken handoff — and zoom out to design the processes, playbooks, and automation that stop the same problems from recurring.  

  

This is a high\-visibility, build\-from\-scratch role: you'll be judged on the systems and habits you install, not just the projects you close.

#### **How** **You'll** **Make an Impact:**


**Automation \& AI\-native ways of working**


* Identify repetitive, manual workflows across annotation, QA, imagery processing and reporting, and drive their automation — via internal tooling, scripting, RPA, or AI\-assisted workflows.
* Build and own the automation roadmap and drive it seamlessly across the team


**Program \& project management**


* Run structured program governance (milestones, RAID logs, status cadence) across cross\-functional initiatives that no single manager owns end\-to\-end.
* Bring discipline — timelines, ownership, dependencies — to all team initiatives


**Cost reduction**


* Own a cost\-efficiency roadmap for Ops: vendor spend, tooling spends, rework/error costs, and capacity utilization.
* Build the business case and track savings with real numbers\- Clear visible impact


**Vendor performance frameworks**


* Design and own scorecards/SLAs for imagery, annotation and other third\-party vendors.
* Run regular vendor performance reviews and own escalation/renewal/replacement decisions in partnership with managers.


**Cross\-functional ownership \& data ownership**


* Serve as the connective tissue across all managers and leads — surfacing shared problems (tooling, process, vendor etc) that no single manager can fix alone.
* Own org\-wide SOP creation and the dashboard/metrics layer (throughput, quality, SLA, utilization) so every manager works off the same numbers.


**Enable leadership with insight and structure**


* Build dashboards/reports tracking throughput, accuracy, vendor performance, and cost efficiency; define KPIs that drive decisions on quality, capacity, and cost
* Manage budgets across data sourcing, annotation ops, and vendor contracts, identifying cost\-optimization opportunities
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured, actionable plans


#### **What We're Looking For:**


* 5\+ years of experience spanning program/project management, business operations, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to automation, Ops, vendor management and cost optimization.
* A genuine track record of building metrics/automation programs from scratch — not just running ones someone else designed.
* Comfort with data: you should be able to build and defend a dashboard or a business case yourself, not just commission one.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the face of Ops in external conversations.
* Experience managing external vendors/partners and negotiating SLAs.
* Bonus: prior exposure to GIS, geospatial, imagery, or annotation\-heavy operations; experience standing up automation/RPA/AI tooling programs (This is not mandatory)
* Must\-have: hands\-on experience working in a startup environment.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Company Introduction**



We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.



We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.



Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.


**Role Overview**



The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next\-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.



As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business\-critical outcomes.



This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.



The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large\-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.


**What You Will Do**


* Lead strategic, organization\-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
* Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
* Drive large\-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
* Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
* Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
* Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision\-making, and resource allocation.
* Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
* Drive executive\-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
* Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed systems environments.
* Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
* Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.


**Type of work model**



Hybrid /Onsite / Remote working


* Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.


**Details to consider**



Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.



Privacy Notice


* Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/
